# Generic method default fold

Kotlin 2.0.21 all-compatibility output retains a method-owned Object-bounded
formal, an exact seed and complete mixed-variance binary callback. A frozen
Java observer distinguishes inherited default dispatch from an overriding
receiver through ordinary calls, DefaultImpls, reflection and MethodHandles.
It checks method scope, receiver/seed/result identity, callback snapshots,
nulls and exact partial failures. Original Code bytes remain compiler output;
the reported private helper must keep the entire original generic Signature.
